Flags.HelpText: Save multisurface textures as one large image, tiled across in the Y (vertical) direction

Flags.HelpText: Combine all surfaces into one image (only supported on TIF and DDS)

Flags.Name: grayscale
Flags.HelpText: Convert single channel textures to grayscale RGB

Flags.Name: use-texture-decoder
Flags.HelpText: Use TextureDecoder for decoding textures, slower but more accurate (enforced on Linux)
